name: Disadvantaged High School Student Summer Research Program
org: University of Arizona College of Medicine, Tucson
what_you_do: Work as a paid summer research helper. It is at the University of Arizona College of Medicine in Tucson. The research is medical.
who_can_apply: High school students, especially juniors and seniors. They come from backgrounds that are hard in money, school or social ways. You need a 3.0 GPA, 2 recommendation letters, a science fair or research example, U.S. citizenship or a permanent visa, and a Social Security number.
pay_detail: Federal minimum hourly wage, 40 hours a week for the length of the program
duration: June 1 to July 17, 2026. Full time, Monday to Friday.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed Jan 16, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Email or mail the form, a 1 to 2 page essay, 2 signed letters, a signed transcript and a statement of your background. The essay topic is "Why I love science and what the summer medical research apprenticeship will mean to me".
notes: The 2026 form has a Social Security Number field. The program gives no rides. The last deadline was in January. Questions: MSRP@surgery.arizona.edu or (520) 626-0861.
